title: xAI API key: one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 41-character body, about half the 80-character example length, length: 79-character body vs the 80 characters the provider example and every tool rule use, and length: 81-character body vs the 80-character example length. Twin of "xAI API key: must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of xai-api-key-bearer-header: length: 81-character body vs the 80-character example length. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
